text:
A task button now saves its verb (`{"start":{}}`) through the item tool's writer, but the full path was not run end to end. Servex has not been restarted, so `POST /api/item` has not been called from a browser. It is built in branch `worktree/qf-1`, commits `2d4e6486c` and `e5105980b`, and nothing is merged.

**Tests**
- `act.test.mjs` passes 9 checks: `run_item` as the owner writes `{"start":{},"by":"owner","ts":…}` and a fresh replay is running; `Item.act` records one verb line and no state lines; a refused verb records nothing; the echo skip ignores `by`/`ts`.
- `Servex/agents/item_tool.test.mjs` fails on "session.jsonl -> Session, tasks.add, completion 1/2". It fails the same way in the main tree, so it predates this work.

**Shot:** `core/Item/tasks/ui-actions-as-deltas/build/shot-400.png` (400px, `/framework/core/Task/`). It shows the Pause and Stop buttons on a running row, and they fit.

**What was built**
- `Servex/Servex.js` has `POST /api/item`, which calls `run_item` as the owner. It refuses non-loopback callers, and a worktree page's post is stubbed rather than written.
- `Item.act(verb, args)` runs the verb locally, then emits one delta with the verb. A static `Store.muted` counter keeps the `set` lines from that local run out of the log.
- `Store.flush` posts each line to `/api/item`. If Servex doesn't answer, it falls back to `FsFile.send` with a one-time warning. A line the tool refuses is dropped with a warning. The echo check now ignores `by` and `ts`.
- `Task.can(verb)` reads the existing state map. `TaskView` shows Start, Pause, Resume, Stop and Approve as 44px icon buttons on rows and cards. A click calls `task.act(verb)` and does not toggle the row.

**Decisions that differ from the brief**
- Only `task.jsonl`, `session.jsonl` and `improvements.jsonl` go through the tool; `page.jsonl` keeps the plain append. I did this so a stricter validator can't silently drop page edits. Say if pages should go through too.
- The brief's shot page, `/framework/core/Task/live/`, doesn't use `TaskView`, so I shot `/framework/core/Task/` instead.
- "Refused" is detected by counting deltas during the local call, so a verb that changed nothing records nothing.
- Local `set` events still fire for views. Only the store ignores them.

Restart Servex after the merge. `core/Item/readme.md`, `core/Item/doc/map.md` and the `core/Task` readme are now out of date: Store writes tasks through `/api/item`, and `TaskView` has the buttons and `Task.can`. The report is also logged in `build/session.jsonl`.
